facts.clause: While in Brush, Rengar leaps at his target with his basic attack.
At Max Ferocity, his next ability is empowered.
Rengar's next Attack brutally stabs his target for bonus damage.
additionally cleanses Rengar of crowd control.
Rengar lets out a battle roar, damaging enemies and healing for some of the recent damage he has taken.
Rengar throws a bola, slowing the first target hit for a short duration.
During Thrill of the Hunt, Rengar gains Move Speed and he can leap to the tracked enemy without being in brush, reducing their armor.
Rengar's predatory instincts take over, Camouflaging him and revealing the nearest enemy champion in a large radius around him.
